title: Slice out the first three and last three items
description:
Slice out the first three items and the last three items from food_stuff_lt list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as first_and_last_three(food_stuff_lt), where food_stuff_lt is a list, returning a tuple (first_three, last_three) where first_three and last_three are lists.
hints: You need two separate slices from the same list: one from the start, one from the end.
Python slicing supports leaving one side of the colon blank to mean 'from the beginning' or 'to the end', and negative indices count from the end.
Return (food_stuff_lt[:3], food_stuff_lt[-3:]) - the first slice takes the first 3 items, the second takes the last 3.
expected_behavior: Returns a tuple of two lists: the first three items and the last three items of food_stuff_lt.

hidden_tests.label: six-item list, slices meet exactly in the middle

explanation: food_stuff_lt[:3] slices from the start up to (but not including) index 3, giving the first three items, while food_stuff_lt[-3:] slices from the third-to-last index to the end, giving the last three items.
